verdict.rationale: Bruno supports writing docs alongside collections and publishing them as shareable HTML (bruno-docs-20), plus AI-assisted doc generation per request (bruno-docs-53, bruno-docs-59) and a rich text docs editor (bruno-docs-12). However, this is collection-level request documentation rather than full OpenAPI/spec-based documentation generation, and there's no evidence of publishing to a hosted doc site, versioned doc portals, or spec-driven (OpenAPI/Swagger) doc generation. missing for 10: OpenAPI/spec-based doc generation, hosted/versioned documentation portal, independent corroboration of doc publishing quality.
